pages.title: A Cold Reception
pages.text: Try the native key interaction after acquiring a real key.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find the chest and obtain its key through the frozen adventure. This checks the key-on-chest click, not looting the chest; its contents still follow native rules.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Defeat Cornelia through canonical encounter rules and recover the Frozen Key. The key opens a chest hidden deep in the Ice Maze.
